## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (3)
- `GET /_marketing_assets/_next/data/{dataToken}/{dataId}` — Retrieve data required for authentication flows.
- `GET /_marketing_assets/_next/data/{dataToken}/creators/podcasts.json` — Get podcast creator data for authentication flows.
- `GET /_marketing_assets/_next/data/{dataToken}/en-GB/creators/podcasts.json` — Get GB podcast creator data for authentication flows.

### Data Read (4)
- `GET /_marketing_assets/assets/data/uil.1770761316632.json` — Retrieve marketing asset data.
- `GET /api/v1/components/groups/` — Retrieve information about content groups.
- `GET /api/v3/status` — Check the overall status of the Floatplane service.
- `GET /cm/{cmId}/translations/en.json` — Get English translations for a specific content item.

### Media (1)
- `GET /api/badges/download-on-the-app-store/black/en-us` — Download a badge image for the App Store.

### Realtime (1)
- `POST /slurp/v2/events` — Send real-time event data to Floatplane.

```typescript
  try {
    const groups = await client.getApiV1ComponentsGroups();
    console.log("Content Groups:", groups);
    return groups;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching content groups:", error);
    return null;
  }
}

getContentGroups();
```

```typescript
async function sendEvent(eventData: any) {
  try {
    const response = await client.postSlurpV2Events(eventData);
    console.log("Event sent:", response);
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error sending event:", error);
    return null;
  }
}

const exampleEvent = {
  event: "video_started",
  videoId: "12345",
  userId: "67890",

sendEvent(exampleEvent);
```

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Floatplane's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Floatplane data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.floatplane.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Floatplane frontend uses
